Lean Turkey Chili
Servings 6

Ingredients
1 tbsp olive oil
1 medium onion, diced
2 lbs 93% lean ground turkey
1 (28 oz) can crushed tomatoes
2 (15 oz) cans kidney beans, drained
1 cup chicken broth
2 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp smoked paprika
1-2 jalapeños, minced

Instructions
Heat the olive oil in a large pot and cook the onion until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add the ground turkey and cook until no longer pink, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes, kidney beans, chicken broth, chili powder, smoked paprika and jalapeños.
Simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Notes
Freezes well for up to 3 months.
